about: FR-49/51/52/53 reflex and clock knobs (docs/v2/CONTRACTS.md §9.18). The kernel reads this file at boot (K.cfg.reflex); a missing or invalid file or key means the built-in defaults shown here. clock.trade_cap: FPS cap while trade has the trade screen open (until the caravan visit ends). predator_near: a wild danger (and an invader the raws call an animal: a mount or pet left behind) counts only inside Kern+ or within this many tiles of a citizen outside it (0 = no limit). lockdown_near (Run 11): a lockdown also ends after hold_quiet_days without a visible invader within this many tiles of a citizen outside Kern+ or of an entrance, with invaders in sight farther away (LOCKDOWN_END cause far); those count for nothing (ALERT ends too) until one comes that close, which re-arms the lockdown at once (0 = off: threat 0 only). Actions: clock (timestream off, FPS cap at clock.siege_cap), gates (every linked drawbridge up), doors (entrance doors forbidden: next to open sky and on seal's entrance routes), alert (civ alert; seal picks the burrow: Kern+, else Innen+, kept for the lockdown; only a burrow no entrance reaches without a door, else the dead end Tiefe+, else none and the citizens flee). refuge: beds >= ceil(citizens x bed_pct / 100) (a shortfall only ranks the burrows, 0 = no bed count); in a breach the separated refuge and the dead end hold the citizens without drink/food/bed counts for breach_days game days. gate (BUG-027): every pull waits while a unit that is not hostile stands on or next to the footprint; force_near = tiles (0-30, 0 never) a visible hostile must be from the footprint before a SIEGE/BREACH raise goes ahead onto such a unit (GATE_FORCED); manual = bridge names (B1) or building ids (17880) that get no automatic pull at all (stop-gap: the bridge then stays down in a siege, GATE_FAIL manual, BREACH at T+900 for an outer/inner one). intake (Gordon 2026-10-16, SIEGE): waves let into the bailey, trap hall and killing field through O1 while B1 stays up; on = the default; wave = hostiles inside before O1 rises (at most the soldiers on station); min_soldiers and worn (%) = the squads a wave needs on station; army_ratio = visible hostiles at most this many times the soldiers; cooldown = ticks after a wave (drink, food); danger_dist = tiles from O1 at which a dangerous hostile (great danger, building destroyer, trap avoider, flier) closes it; stable = ticks of SIEGE before the first wave; losses = citizens lost in a wave that close it (WAVE_FAIL); muster = ticks the squads have to reach the field; fight = ticks until a wave that is not cleared is WAVE_FAIL stuck. sortie (squad.sortie with gate, approved): worn (%) and the combat value against foe_cv per hostile within near tiles of the target before it starts; losses and max_ticks recall it; gather = ticks to gather in the bailey. stations (BUG-030, SIEGE): the deep defense sends the civilians to the separated refuge (the BREACH level) and every squad to the core station (stations.b2) when building destroyers are in sight, the visible hostiles exceed core_ratio x the soldiers, or the squads are weak: worn (%) below worn or the share of soldiers in iron/steel below metal (%, 0 = not checked); no intake wave then. stations.spread (BUG-032): the tiles around its station point DF stands a squad's soldiers on; military keeps every squad station more than gate's margin (1) + spread tiles from every bridge footprint (else the nearest revealed floor on the inner side, else the next station) and re-stations a squad whose soldiers at their station hold a raise. perimeter (BUG-030 rebuild policy): a lost bridge is built again only in quiet PEACE (never in SIEGE, BREACH, ALERT, RECOVERY or a lockdown); a manifest bridge destroyed stop_after times by building destroyers since the player's last answer (verb bridge.rebuild) is not rebuilt automatically any more (DECISION_NEEDED bridge_rebuild; 0 = always rebuilt). confine (BUG-065, Run 14): a lockdown ends by itself after max_days game days (10; 0 = off) in PEACE/ALERT unless a dangerous hostile is within the near radius (inside Kern+, lockdown_near of a citizen outside it or of an entrance, or of unknown distance) or a trigger came in the last 2,400 ticks; harmless = no great danger, undead, building destroyer, large predator, trap avoider or flier, with a body size up to harmless_size (cm3, 20000; a dwarf is 60000; 0 = size rule off) or a race token in harmless_races (for example GREMLIN), at most lone_max (2) of them; offer_days: a harmless intruder that held the lockdown that long gets a squad.sortie offer (DECISION_NEEDED intruder_sortie), repeated only for another unit or a changed cause, at the earliest after offer_days; need_thirst / need_hunger: a mood dwarf or patient behind the sounding alert over these counters is reported (DECISION_NEEDED confined_need) and, with nothing dangerous near, the lockdown ends for him. popups (FR-75): other = also clear popups of unknown text after other_s real seconds on the screen (false by default: the kernel clears only the kinds it names; threat and embark words are never cleared), log_s = real seconds between two kern.log lines per popup kind.
